verdict.rationale: Mistral documents multilingual OCR across 40+ languages, and its OCR 4 announcement claims 170 languages. A hands-on community test of a bidi English/Hebrew document concretely contradicts the right-to-left fidelity claim: the Hebrew output did not match the source text and was instead a back-translation of the English. Missing for 10: explicit CJK support or benchmarks, documented right-to-left/bidi handling, and independent evidence that non-English fidelity matches English.

support.subject: As a developer, non-English documents — including CJK and right-to-left scripts — parse with the same fidelity as English

citations.quote: Multilingual OCR performs strongly across more than 40 languages.
Support for 170 languages across 10 language groups, with measurable gains on specialized and low-resource languages
